description: This file defines a React functional component named Navbar, which provides the navigation bar for an admin panel. It includes links to various sections like Dashboard, Users, Requests, Fees, Analytics, and SMS Demo, as well as logout functionality.

methods.name: Navbar({ user })
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar with links and logout button based on user authentication state.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function triggered on clicking the logout button, calls dataService.logout and navigates to login page.
